jobs.description:
**Company Description**

StarTekk’s adoption of Digital Transformation is to accelerate organizational growth, increase efficiencies and help Star Workforce achieve focused business goals. The Employee will help our organization to identify and bridge the gap that exists in the business by analyzing the data, scale and support digital transformation initiatives.

 **Job Description**

**Project details (project overview, who the contractor will work with, soft skills needed, etc.):**  
This position will be reporting to the Project Delivery Unit Supervisor. This role will work cross functionally with other team members but will primarily be an independent contributor. This team needs a senior project manager who has led a large software implementation or rollout through the execution and deployment phases. They should be experienced coordinating internal teams and vendors, managing rollout readiness, and planning communications for stakeholders and people affected by the change. The project has several connected workstreams, so the person should be comfortable managing an integrated schedule, dependencies, risks, decisions, and issues while keeping leaders and delivery teams aligned. Experience leading a complex, cross-functional project is more important than a specific budget amount or number of simultaneous projects.  
  
**Additional details:** This person leads large public-health technology projects, coordinates teams, manages schedules and budgets, helps implement software systems, and ensures that data and technology improvements are delivered successfully and safely for the State of Wisconsin. Light Travel within the state10%-20%.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Managing the complete project and product delivery life cycle, from evaluation and initiation through implementation, operational transition, and closure.
* Establishing and maintaining governance, delivery controls, escalation pathways, decision-making processes, and performance measures.
* Developing estimates and tracking scope, schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, risks, dependencies, quality, and outcomes.
* Preparing and presenting clear status reports, recommendations, decision materials, implementation plans, and executive-level communications.
* Identifying opportunities to improve organizational processes, systems, data practices, reporting capabilities, and service delivery.
* Developing, implementing, evaluating, and continuously improving standards, policies, procedures, templates, tools, and practices.
* Coordinating internal staff, vendors, contractors, and external partners to ensure accountability and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Training, coaching, and mentoring staff to strengthen project management, product management, data management, business analysis, change management, and delivery capabilities.
* Supporting the safe, confidential, effective, and strategic collection and use of public health information.

The incumbent is expected to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and provide leadership on complex and evolving issues. The position requires the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines, respond effectively to changing priorities, shift attention across competing needs, identify when matters require escalation, and maintain progress in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

**GOALS AND WORKER ACTIVITIES:**

* Manage complex projects, including timelines, and quality goals. Lead implementation of major OHI initiatives. These projects will range from moderately to significantly complex programs.
* Work with OHI leadership to develop project charters ensuring that the scope of projects is defined. Projects may be related to wide range of data-related topics, e.g., policies, gaps, communications, training, access, use, release, security, and privacy.

Prepare and distribute project team meeting agendas and assure meeting notes include attendees, decisions made, and next steps.
* Develop and maintain effective and collaborative working relationships with partners, leadership, and other members throughout DPH to develop and implement program initiatives.
* Lead discovery sessions and project management coordination activities. Monitor progress and report on the overall status of projects.
* Assist the DPH Leadership with strategic guidance using tools and data to support strategies presented. The Senior Project manager must deliver in a systems thinking approach to delivery and continuous improvement.
* Monitor annual action plans and provide progress and financial tracking status reports on active projects.
* Evaluate effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery related activities and recommend solutions to management for strategic direction.
* Be aware of complex federal and state regulations regarding data use, access, confidentiality, and other data related issues.
* Consider short term and long term plans to achieve OHI project delivery goals.
* Coordinate with the Team member and other staff to plan, schedule, track, document, and communicate project status, risks and mitigation strategies.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Element Science, Inc. is a medical device and digital health company redefining how patients with heart disease are monitored and treated as they transition from the hospital to the home. Our mission is to improve outcomes for patients at risk of life-threatening cardiac events through innovative solutions at the intersection of clinical-grade wearables, advanced algorithms, and therapy delivery.

We are entering an exciting phase of growth as we move from development into early commercialization. Our approach combines hardware, software, and services to deliver a more personalized and seamless patient experience—designed with both patients and clinicians in mind. Our product, a wearable patch defibrillator, is designed for patients with a temporary elevated risk of sudden cardiac arrest, addressing a significant and underserved population of over 500,000 patients in the U.S. By focusing on comfort, usability, and clinical effectiveness, we aim to transform the standard of care during this critical period. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Element Science is backed by leading healthcare and technology investors, including Third Rock Ventures, GV (Google Ventures), Deerfield Healthcare, Cormorant Asset Management, and Invus Opportunities.

**SUMMARY OF ROLE:**

Element Science is seeking an experienced **Technical Project Manager** to lead complex, cross-functional projects spanning the full medical device product lifecycle, from early-stage research and development through design, verification and validation, manufacturing, commercialization, and ultimately into the hands of patients who depend on our life-saving technology.

This role offers the opportunity to drive meaningful technical initiatives that bridge innovation and real-world patient impact. Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, and Operations, the Technical Project Manager will align teams, navigate technical challenges, manage risks, and drive execution to ensure products are developed, manufactured, and delivered with the highest standards of quality, safety, and reliability.

The ideal candidate brings **hands-on experience guiding medical devices from concept through commercialization**, a strong understanding of the technical and regulatory complexities across the product lifecycle, and the ability to translate innovative ideas into successful product outcomes. We are looking for a collaborative, solutions-oriented leader who takes ownership, thrives in a dynamic environment, and is motivated by seeing technology make a meaningful difference in patients' lives.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead cross-functional projects spanning early-stage R&D, product development, design verification and validation, design transfer, manufacturing scale-up, commercialization, and sustaining engineering.
* Partner with technical and operational teams to ensure seamless transitions between development phases, maintaining alignment on product requirements, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.
* Drive project readiness for key development milestones, including design reviews, verification and validation, manufacturing readiness, and commercial launch.
* Support ongoing product improvements informed by manufacturing performance, field experience, and patient needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline required.
* 5+ years of experience in the medical device industry, with demonstrated technical project management experience spanning the full product development lifecycle, from R&D and product design through verification and validation, manufacturing, commercialization, and post-market support.
* Demonstrated experience leading medical device projects through the **full product development lifecycle, from concept and R&D through manufacturing, commercialization, and post-market support**.
* Strong understanding of design controls, design transfer, manufacturing readiness, and the cross-functional dependencies involved in bringing regulated medical devices to market.
* Experience translating complex technical requirements into executable project plans that support product quality, patient safety, and successful commercialization.

**BENEFITS:**

Element Science offers a very competitive salary and benefits package including, but not limited to:

* Stock Options
* 90% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company-paid Basic Life Insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan (Traditional and Roth)
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* FSA (Flexible Spending Accounts)
* HSA (Health Savings Account)
* Employee Assistance Program through PEO

The salary for this exempt-level position will be based on experience and qualifications within an established pay range.

* Pay range: $140,000 - $160,000

Element Science is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All candidates will be evaluated on the basis of their qualifications for the job in question. We do not base our employment decision on an employee's or applicant's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit-based factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

*In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. We are not able to sponsor individuals for employment visas for this job.*

*At this time, we are unable to offer relocation assistance at Element Science.*

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

OLR is an award-winning Oracle Retail Partner with over 20 years of experience delivering and supporting Oracle Retail solutions for international omnichannel retailers and some of the world’s most recognized brands.

OLR is a global technology consulting company that partners with leading retailers and brands to deliver innovative commerce and supply chain solutions. With team members located across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, we combine global expertise with local knowledge to support clients around the world.

**The Role:**

The Senior Project Manager plays a crucial role in the successful delivery of large-scale Oracle Retail and omni-channel implementation projects. This position requires a proven leader capable of managing complex, multi-stream programs while aligning stakeholders and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, all while maintaining the highest levels of client satisfaction.

Operating within a global delivery environment, the Senior Project Manager will lead cross-functional teams across multiple regions, ensuring consistency in execution and adherence to OLR's delivery methodologies. This role demands strong commercial awareness, effective stakeholder management skills, and a comprehensive understanding of the software delivery lifecycle.

**In this role, you'll:**

  

* Lead the planning, execution, and governance of large-scale Oracle Retail or enterprise technology implementations.

* Define and manage project scope, deliverables, timelines, and budgets to meet client and internal objectives.

* Establish robust project governance, ensuring effective risk, issue, and change management.

* Oversee project plans and progress against KPIs, applying corrective actions where needed.

* Ensure all documentation, reporting, and communication meet OLR and client standards.

* Serve as the primary liaison for senior client stakeholders, building trusted, long-term relationships.

* Lead executive meetings and steering committees, ensuring clear communication of status and strategy.

* Collaborate with internal leaders, consultants, and technical teams to align project outcomes with business goals.

* Lead, mentor, and motivate multi-disciplinary teams across regions, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.

* Manage budgets, forecasts, and profitability, ensuring financial transparency and alignment with delivery milestones.

* Identify and pursue opportunities for additional service offerings and scope expansion.

* Ensure consistent application of OLR methodologies, quality standards, and best practices.

* Capture lessons learned and champion continuous process improvements and agile delivery principles.

**Experience & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

* 8+ years of experience in IT or software project management, including 5+ years managing large-scale enterprise Oracle Retail implementations.

* Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-country or multi-phase technology projects on time and within budget.

* Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional and distributed teams in a global delivery environment.

* Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycles (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid) and PM best practices.

* Exceptional stakeholder and client management skills, including experience with C-level executives.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication abilities.

* Commercially astute with experience in project financial management and forecasting.

* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, and MS Office suite.

* PMP, Prince2, or Agile Project Management certification strongly preferred.
* This role may require domestic and international travel to support project delivery across regions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Strategic thinking and problem-solving with a results-driven mindset.

* Confident communicator with excellent presentation and negotiation skills.

* Adaptable, calm under pressure, and able to make decisive judgments in dynamic environments.

* Proven ability to balance multiple priorities and manage competing demands.

* Passionate about quality, process improvement, and delivering client success.

**Why join OLR?**

  

* Make a global impact by contributing to retail transformation projects across regions.

* Collaborate with international teams across UK, Portugal, US, Canada, Mexico, India.

* Grow your career through structured training, professional development, and career progression opportunities.

* Join a certified Great Place to Work with a culture that values collaboration, innovation, and community.

**Benefits you’ll enjoy:**

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include:

* Competitive compensation
* Paid vacation and holidays

* Health and wellness benefits

* Professional development and learning opportunities

* Flexible work arrangements (where applicable)

  

**Please note:** Specific benefits and eligibility vary by country and are discussed during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Industrial Controls, R&D
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What we need**

Symbotic is seeking for an ICS Technical Program Manager, R&D to join our Industrial Controls Program Management team within our Industrial Controls organization. Your job will be to lead Industrial Controls workstreams for strategic customer NPI programs, aligning engineering, product, manufacturing, suppliers, and operations to deliver production-ready automation systems safely, on time, and within budget.

**What we do**

The Industrial Controls Program Management team is part of the Industrial Controls organization, which is responsible for developing, integrating, validating, and launching controls technologies that enable Symbotic’s automated systems. The team focuses on cross-functional governance across PLC and controls, electrical engineering, software and internal tools, manufacturing, and field operations to ensure Symbotic’s automated warehouse solutions remain stable, scalable, and high-performing.

**What you'll do**

* Lead end-to-end Industrial Controls workstream execution for strategic customer NPI programs, managing multiple concurrent projects from design through NPI readiness and launch support.
* Establish, organize, and rigorously maintain workstream budgets, scope baselines, integrated master schedules, and program plans using Microsoft Project and Jira.
* Own relationships with external controls vendors and systems integrators, including scope alignment, SOW governance, milestone tracking, deliverable verification, and executive escalations.
* Build and actively manage risk registers covering technical, vendor, manufacturing, schedule, and financial risks; drive owned mitigations to closure and escalate early when baselines are at risk.
* Coordinate across Product, Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Internal Tools Software, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Field Operations to keep each workstream tightly synchronized.
* Lead technical reviews, design reviews, gate reviews, and executive status reviews, providing clear, data-driven reporting to program leadership, executive stakeholders, and customer-facing teams.
* Support prototype builds, engineering validation, system integration, manufacturing readiness, FAT/SAT activities, pilot builds, site commissioning, engineering change control, BOM releases, and configuration management.

**What you'll need**

* Minimum of 8 years of related experience or equivalent work experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, including Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Systems, Software, or a related field.
* Proven experience delivering complex, multidisciplinary electro-mechanical, robotics, automation, or industrial systems through the full NPI lifecycle.
* Demonstrated success taking complex hardware and software systems from concept through design validation, prototype builds, FAT/SAT, pilot lines, and production scale-up.
* Experience owning workstream budgets, scope baselines, integrated master schedules, and active risk registers, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Office.
* Strong experience managing external vendors, suppliers, and systems integrators, including SOWs, milestones, performance tracking, deliverable verification, and escalations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional engineering teams and resource managers without direct authority, supported by strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with Rockwell Automation and Studio 5000, Beckhoff, Siemens, industrial safety systems, or warehouse automation is preferred.

**Our Environment**

* Up to 30% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ.
* Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.

We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

**The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)**

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

**Role summary**

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work. You will be the person who tracks, communicates, and resolves cross-team dependencies so engineers can stay focused on technical delivery, and leaders can focus on strategy and people.

* Manage the OKR and epic portfolio across all three programs, including creation, refinement, sequencing, and status tracking.

* Work with team leads, so each team's agile funnel reflects current priorities and supports committed delivery dates.
* Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early.
* Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio.
* Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones.
* Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early.
* Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education.
* A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies.
* Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile).
* Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
* The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management.
* Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives.
* Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence.
* Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping.
* PMP, SAFe, or similar certification (nice to have, not required).

**Success measures for the first 6 to 12 months**

* A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM.
* Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates.

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Sr. Project Manager, UK**

**Location: Remote, UK Only**

**About The Company:**

MustardSeed PMO designs and delivers project management solutions for complex, regulated sectors. We build PMOs, plan, staff, and run projects and programs, and provide seasoned project managers on demand.

We’re known for fast, structured onboarding that plugs in quickly and builds momentum. Our frameworks improve communication, control, and execution to drive better decisions and measurable results.

We support clients across life sciences, aerospace, food, tech, and financial services aligning PM discipline to each organization’s stage.

**About the Role:**

As a Sr. Project Manager at MustardSeed, you will be contributing to end-to-end project delivery within specified timeframes, budgets, and quality standards. As an experienced project manager already, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure the best possible outcomes, steering multidisciplinary teams towards common goals.

The Sr. Project Manager is the chief “make sure it happens – and happens right” person on the project and has the overall responsibility for ensuring that the outputs from each project phase – the initiation, planning, execution and closing phases – are delivered according to the requirements established and approved for that phase, and that these outputs are consistent across all phases.

You will contribute to a wide variety of different projects while maintaining a focus on project management best practices and stakeholder satisfaction.

Previous projects our team has facilitated include but are not limited to creating a robust integrated master schedule (IMS) for an upcoming clinical trial, identifying, and eliminating bottlenecks in a new product introduction (NPI) process, completing a transformative overhaul of a client’s product lifecycle management (PLM) process, ensuring the successful delivery of a newly acquired software, overhauling a client’s supply chain management (SCM) practices.

If you are highly skilled and enjoy challenging, important work while retaining the flexibility your life needs, we would like to talk to you!

**Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):**

* Ensure that communication within and between organizations involved in the various phases is occurring effectively, and that management and other stakeholders are kept informed of progress, as necessary.
* Develop a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress while managing changes to project scope, project schedule, and project cost.
* Define project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility.
* Perform project risk assessments, including, among others, the risk of exceeding the budget, not meeting schedules, and technology risks.
* Understand, assess, and embed the right delivery methodologies, considering the project and business constraints.
* Utilize appropriate Program Management Best Practices throughout the project duration.
* Track project performance, specifically to analyze the successful completion of short and long-term goals.
* Meet budgetary objectives and adjust project constraints based on financial analysis.

**Skills Required:**

* Proven track record of delivery, ideally with at least 5 years in a project management role.
* Ability to think strategically and tactically about product, technical, and cross-functional issues.
* Excellent client-facing and internal verbal and written communication skills.
* High-caliber organizational skills (e.g., attention to detail, multitasking, etc.).
* Proven leadership and experience in project management.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) / Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus.

**Additional Information:**

MustardSeed provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Compensation Range:** £60,000 to £75,000/annually

**A quick note about this opportunity:**

MustardSeed is a project management consulting firm. Our project managers are embedded within our clients' organizations to lead and support critical initiatives across multiple industries. As we continue to grow and bring on new clients, we're continually expanding our team of experienced project managers. While this may be the same role you've seen before, it's because we're building our talent pipeline to meet ongoing client demand.

Compensation Range: $92K - $138K

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

* **Drive project execution:** Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, deliverables, and ownership assignments to keep work moving toward defined outcomes.

* **Coordinate across teams:** Partner with Product, Technology, Customer Success, Support, Operations, and other stakeholders to align activities, track dependencies, and support effective handoffs.

* **Manage project risks and issues:** Proactively identify, document, and monitor risks, blockers, and dependencies, escalating significant concerns with clear context and potential next steps.

* **Create project visibility:** Maintain accurate project documentation, progress trackers, action logs, and status reports to give stakeholders a reliable understanding of progress and priorities.

* **Support effective project meetings:** Coordinate working sessions, prepare agendas, document decisions and action items, and follow through with owners to maintain momentum.

* **Improve ways of working:** Identify opportunities to simplify project tracking, strengthen reporting accuracy, and introduce repeatable practices or appropriate automation that make teams more effective.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* Practical experience managing projects, coordinating workstreams, or supporting complex cross-functional initiatives.

* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project plans, track milestones, organize deliverables, and manage competing deadlines.

* Experience working with stakeholders across multiple functions, aligning activities, communicating updates, and maintaining clear ownership of next steps.

* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including risk and issue tracking, dependency management, status reporting, and escalation processes.

* Ability to bring structure to changing priorities or incomplete information, identify what needs clarification, and make progress while seeking guidance when appropriate.

* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365, or similar platforms.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain reliable project information and follow through on commitments.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to facilitate productive discussions and collaborate respectfully across teams.  

  

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE**

* Experience supporting Product, Technology, SaaS, or customer-facing initiatives.

* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, waterfall, or hybrid project delivery approaches.

* Experience preparing project dashboards, leadership updates, or structured reporting.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools or workflow automation to improve project documentation, reporting, and coordination, with appropriate review for accuracy and confidentiality.

A project management certification such as CAPM, PMP, Scrum, or a comparable credential.  

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **Reliable project execution:** Project plans, milestones, dependencies, and ownership are consistently maintained, giving teams a clear view of what needs to happen next.

* **Improved visibility:** Stakeholders receive timely, accurate progress updates, with risks, issues, and changes clearly documented.

* **Stronger follow-through:** Action items and commitments are tracked consistently, with potential delays identified and escalated early.

* **Effective collaboration:** Cross-functional teams understand their responsibilities, dependencies, and immediate priorities.

* **Continuous improvement:** Project management practices become more consistent, organized, and efficient, reducing avoidable rework and improving delivery predictability.





Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

USA based candidates - $97,200 - $109,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

jobs.description:
The **Group Project Manager** is a senior project management leader responsible for the successful planning and delivery of integrated client work across one or more lines of business. This role leads cross-functional teams from planning through execution, ensuring work is delivered on schedule, within scope and budget, and in accordance with agency processes and quality standards. The Group Project Manager also manages and develops junior PM team members, partners with Account leadership on annual planning and scope management, and proactively addresses operational, financial, resource, and timeline risks.

**Main Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end project and program management for complex, integrated pharmaceutical advertising work across digital, print, video, and other channels.
* Partner with Account leadership to translate annual client plans and statements of work into actionable project, timeline, budget, and resource plans.
* Oversee integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies, responsibilities, and approval requirements across multiple concurrent projects and lines of business.
* Manage, mentor, and develop junior project managers; provide workload oversight, escalation support, onboarding, and coaching.
* Monitor scope, hours, budgets, project burn, out-of-pocket costs, and resource utilization; identify changes early and support change control and project actualization.
* Champion agency workflow and quality standards, resolve operational or resource bottlenecks, lead clear status communications, and recommend process improvements.
* And other job duties as assigned by the line manager.

**Education & Experience**

*Minimum Education & Experience:*

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Seven or more years of direct project management experience, including project planning, budget development, execution, and delivery.
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare advertising, or other regulated-industry experience required.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex integrated work and developing project management staff.

*Preferred Education & Experience (optional):*

* Advertising agency experience.
* Experience with Workfront or a comparable workflow platform.
* Experience managing digital, print, and video/broadcast production.

*Or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.*

**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

* Expertise in project management principles, methods, workflow, and integrated delivery.
* Strong financial management skills, including scope input, resource planning, budget tracking, forecasting, actualization, and change control.
* Ability to lead complex, concurrent workstreams while maintaining visibility to priorities, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
* Demonstrated people leadership, coaching, delegation, and performance-development capabilities.
* Strong cross-functional leadership across Account, Strategy, Creative, Medical, Editorial, Production, and Operations.
* Clear, proactive, and solutions-oriented written and verbal communication.
* Sound judgment managing ambiguity, conflict, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Advanced organizational skills and consistent attention to detail and quality assurance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and online workflow tools; Workfront experience is a plus.
* Working knowledge of regulated pharmaceutical advertising processes and review requirements.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About ClearConnect Solutions**

At ClearConnect Solutions, an Acrisure company, we believe there’s a story in your data, and we help our clients see it. We specialize in cutting-edge, data-driven technology solutions for fleet insurers, underwriters, and policyholders. From real-time risk score monitoring, automated Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) services, and screening platforms to advanced telematics and route optimization, our software empowers the transportation and insurance industries to mitigate risk, streamline compliance, and build safer driver workforces.

We are expanding our software development capabilities and looking for a dynamic Product Owner / Project Manager to bridge the gap between business strategy and agile execution.

**Job Summary**

The Product Owner / Project Manager serves a dual-purpose role, driving product vision, backlog, and requirements while keeping the software development team aligned, unblocked, and on schedule. This role owns the product lifecycle from concept through deployment for data and risk-management platforms, leads agile ceremonies, develops precise user stories, and partners with engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable features for the fleet and insurance sectors.

**Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership & Requirements Engineering**

* Backlog Management: Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog, ensuring user stories align with strategic business goals and product roadmaps.
* Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, data analysts, and industry experts to translate complex data workflows, including MVR automation, telematics, and risk scoring, into clear, actionable technical requirements.
* User Story Creation: Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications that provide clear direction for software developers and QA teams.
* Product Roadmap Support: Assist leadership in defining release scopes, tracking milestones, and aligning software releases with company growth objectives.

Project Management & Scrum Leadership

* Scrum Ceremonies: Lead agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Sprint Execution & Delivery: Manage sprint velocity, remove blockers, and help the engineering team deliver high-quality code on schedule.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary communication conduit between technical teams and business stakeholders, manage expectations, and provide transparent project-status updates.
* Process Improvement: Continuously optimize agile workflows, tools, and documentation practices to improve team efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Project Manager, or Scrum Master in an Agile software development environment.
* Strong familiarity with software development life cycles (SDLC), API integrations, and data-heavy platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business language and business needs into technical requirements.
* Analytical mindset and comfort working with complex data systems, risk models, and compliance workflows to define logical product solutions.
* Proficiency with agile project management and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or an equivalent agile certification.
* Experience with SaaS, InsurTech, FinTech, fleet-management technology, or related data-driven platforms.
* Experience supporting products involving MVR automation, telematics, risk scoring, screening, compliance, or route optimization.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* An opportunity to shape innovative software products in the rapidly evolving InsurTech and fleet-safety space.
* A collaborative, data-driven culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.

**About the role:** This position is ideal for an experienced financial analyst or auditor who combines strong financial reconciliation and controls experience with technical skills in SQL and Excel.

  

**Job Summary:**

  

**Financial Data Solutions Analyst III (Senior Financial Data Analyst, Reconciliation & Controls)**  
  
The Financial Data Solutions Analyst III is responsible for establishing, executing, and maintaining reconciliation, validation, certification, and control processes for finance data consumed from the data warehouse (MDP). The role ensures that finance data reconciles to approved authoritative sources, required control activities are executed and documented, variances are investigated and tracked, and supporting evidence is maintained for Finance reporting, close activities, audit readiness, and analytical decision-making.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**

* Maintain and execute reconciliation and validation procedures for finance data consumed from MDP.
* Work with Finance stakeholders and appropriate Operations, Internal Controls, Audit, and Technology partners to define in-scope finance data, authoritative reference sources, validation scope, control frequency, tolerances, evidence requirements, and sign-off responsibilities.
* Reconcile finance data in MDP to approved authoritative sources and document the results.
* Validate balances, record counts, key metrics, and business measures for completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Establish and maintain reconciliation procedures, control schedules, templates, and supporting documentation.
* Identify, investigate, document, and track variances and control exceptions affecting finance data.
* Identify the accountable source or business owner for each in-scope dataset and obtain required owner review, certification, and sign-off.
* Develop and maintain the recurring Finance Data Controls Close Package supporting month-end and year-end close activities.
* Produce finance data readiness assessments identifying risks, unresolved exceptions, accepted variances, and impacts to Finance use.
* Maintain evidence supporting control execution, reconciliations, reviews, approvals, and signoffs.
* Facilitate root-cause analysis of reconciliation variances with accountable business, source-system, and technology owners.
* Maintain the finance data exception register and monitor remediation through resolution or formal risk acceptance.
* Support internal and external audits by providing reconciliation results, certifications, evidence, and control documentation related to finance data in MDP.
* Monitor adherence to control schedules, validation requirements, and close deadlines.

* Technical Reviews: Serve as technical reviewer for internal AI tool requests, evaluating them against architecture, security, data privacy, and interoperability standards.

MTA Bridges and Tunnels operates the largest bridge and tunnel network in New York City, managing nine crossings that include seven bridges and two tunnels. Serving more than 336 million vehicle crossings each year, this network connects communities across the five boroughs and supports regional mobility. In addition, MTA Bridges and Tunnels oversees the Congestion Relief Zone, working to ensure safe, efficient travel and a more sustainable urban environment. MTA strives to provide a safe and reliable commute, excellent customer service, and rewarding opportunities.  
  
  
  
**Telework:**
  
This position is eligible for telework which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.
  
  
**Job Summary:**

The Senior Data Analyst, Revenue Strategy will support MTA Bridges & Tunnels (B&T) in identifying, evaluating, and advancing opportunities to protect, recover, and optimize toll revenue. The position will support Revenue Strategy function through data analysis, performance measurement, reporting, and the development of actionable insights that inform revenue-related initiatives and management decision-making. The Senior Data Analyst will facilitate the development and maintenance of analytical tools, dashboards, and reporting capabilities while working under the direction of the Vice President, Revenue Strategy and in close collaboration with teams across B&T and the broader MTA. The Senior Data Analyst will analyze transactional, customer, payment, accounts receivable, operational, and other relevant data to identify trends, explain variances, evaluate revenue performance, and quantify potential revenue opportunities and risks. The position will also support the development of key performance indicators and analytical frameworks to measure the effectiveness of revenue protection and recovery initiatives. This position is vital to supporting B&T's revenue strategy and requires strong analytical skills, independent judgment, attention to data quality, and the ability to translate complex information into clear findings and recommendations.

The incumbent will work closely with senior staff and cross-functional partners to:

* Conduct complex data cleaning, aggregation, reconciliation, validation, and analysis to distill large and diverse datasets into meaningful metrics, trends, and actionable insights.

* Analyze toll revenue performance and customer payment behavior to identify trends, anomalies, revenue leakage, emerging risks, and opportunities for revenue protection and recovery.

* Analyze accounts receivable, aging, collections, payment activity, and other relevant measures to support an understanding of outstanding balances and revenue recovery performance.

* Develop and maintain key performance indicators, dashboards, analytical tools, and recurring reporting that provide management with visibility into revenue performance and the effectiveness of Revenue Strategy initiatives.

* Evaluate revenue recovery and other strategic initiatives by establishing appropriate baselines, analyzing customer or transaction populations, tracking outcomes, and quantifying financial impact where data permits.

* Conduct revenue recovery, customer payment, segmentation, propensity-to-pay, predictive, trend, variance, root-cause, and scenario analyses to evaluate performance, identify high-priority recovery opportunities, and support data-driven recommendations.

* Perform scenario analysis and develop data-driven business cases to help prioritize revenue opportunities, evaluate potential interventions, and support recommendations to senior management.

* Collaborate with B&T and MTA departments, including Tolling, Finance and Accounting, Revenue Recovery, Operations, Information Technology, Data and Analytics, Legal, and other stakeholders, to obtain and interpret data and address complex revenue-related analytical questions.

* Collaborate with data owners and subject matter experts to ensure timely access to required data and develop a thorough understanding of source datasets, business rules, data quality, and limitations.

* Develop and enhance interactive data visualizations and analytical tools that enable technical and non-technical audiences, including senior management, to understand revenue performance, trends, risks, and potential actions.

* Document analytical methodologies, business rules, data sources, assumptions and processes, and perform appropriate data-quality and validation checks to ensure analytical results are accurate and reproducible.

* Identify, integrate, and analyze new or emerging datasets to address evolving revenue, payment, customer behavior, operational, and policy questions on an as-needed basis.

* Continually identify opportunities to improve Revenue Strategy's analytical and reporting capabilities, including automating recurring analyses, reducing manual processes, improving data accessibility and reliability, and developing tools that allow the organization to identify and respond to revenue issues more quickly.

The Senior Data Analyst will play a role in strengthening the connection between operational activity and financial outcomes, enabling B&T leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening, the potential revenue impact, and what actions may improve performance.

jobs.title: Senior Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior Security Analyst**  
**Atlanta, GA or Washington DC - Hybrid**  
  
Blu Omega is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to support CDC mission needs. This role is responsible for vulnerability management, security assessments, risk mitigation, and continuous security monitoring within federal and regulated technology environments.
  
  
**Program Overview**  
Blu Omega supports CDC modernization efforts to help advance public health outcomes through secure, reliable technology solutions.
  
  
**Key Details**  
Location: Hybrid
  
Clearance / Suitability: Public Trust eligibility required
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform system hardening, vulnerability assessments, Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) remediation, and POA&M tracking across Windows, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Conduct vulnerability scanning and analysis using tools such as Nessus, AppScan, Fortify, WebInspect, SQuirreL, or similar security assessment technologies.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results, document security findings, and map identified risks and deficiencies to NIST SP 800-53 security controls.
* Monitor and support enterprise security tools, including endpoint protection and Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) platforms.
* Support security incident response activities, including investigation, documentation, stakeholder coordination, remediation, and process improvement.
* Conduct system security assessments, threat modeling, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and security audits aligned with federal and industry standards.
* Develop and maintain security governance documentation, including policies, standards, operational procedures, business continuity materials, SA&A artifacts, and compliance reports.
* Partner with system owners, engineers, DevSecOps teams, and stakeholders to validate remediation activities, strengthen access controls, and maintain secure system configurations.
* Support system authorization, continuous monitoring, and ongoing compliance activities to ensure alignment with federal security requirements and organizational objectives.

  
**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, security assessments, and risk mitigation within federal or similarly regulated environments.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning and security assessment tools such as Nessus, AppScan, Fortify, WebInspect, SQuirreL, or similar technologies.
* Experience analyzing vulnerability scan results, identifying security deficiencies, and mapping findings to NIST SP 800-53 security controls.
* Experience performing system security assessments, supporting Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) processes, managing POA&Ms, and maintaining security compliance documentation.
* Knowledge of system hardening, STIG remediation, security configuration management, and vulnerability remediation across enterprise environments.
* Understanding of cybersecurity risk management, incident response, threat identification, and security monitoring practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing security reports, policies, audit documentation, and technical guidance.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Active CDC badge/credentials required.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience supporting federal information security requirements under the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA).
* Experience supporting federal agencies, particularly CDC, NIH, CMS, VA, DoD, or DHS.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, container security, cloud security architecture, and secure software development workflows.
* Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, large-scale modernization initiatives, or federal digital transformation programs.
* Exposure to AI/ML security applications, including anomaly detection, automated security assessments, or AI-driven threat intelligence.
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, privacy-preserving technologies, and emerging AI security risks.
* Experience mentoring junior security analysts or contributing to security strategy and operational improvements.
* DoD 8570/8140-aligned cybersecurity certification, with CISSP preferred.

  
**Compensation**  
Salary Range: $150,000 - $165,000
  
*Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.*  
  
**Blu Omega Benefits & Perks**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term disability (company-paid) and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options available through medical plans
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
* Paid Time Off (PTO) for eligible employees
* Paid federal holidays for salaried employees
* Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits
* Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on role, employment status, and program requirements.

  
**Company Overview**  
Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) delivering technology and cybersecurity solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients nationwide. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments.
  
We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**RealmOne** was built on the principle that people matter first and foremost. We believe in providing a strong work/life balance by investing in our employees and encouraging professional and personal growth. We do this by offering exceptional benefits, flexible schedules, and the tools necessary to achieve success through paid training, mentoring, and the opportunity to work alongside top-notch industry professionals.

We are seeking a **Cyber Security Analysts** to support mission-critical cybersecurity and intelligence operations for a key U.S. Government customer. The Cyber Security Analyst will conduct technical and all-source intelligence research and analysis, with a particular focus on user behavior, anomalous activity, cyber trends, and emerging threats within a dynamic mission environment.

### **The** **Cyber Security Analyst** **shall possess the following capabilities:**

* Conduct research and evaluate technical and all-source intelligence with specific emphasis on user behavior and patterns.
* Analyze complex cyber activity within a dynamic and evolving mission environment.
* Detect anomalous activity within raw and processed log files and conduct deeper analysis using customer specific tools and databases.
* Differentiate between general scanning activity and targeted or suspicious scanning.
* Identify trends across cyber systems and perform behavioral analysis to identify potentially significant activity.
* Utilize Splunk dashboards to create alerts, investigate log files, and support cyber analysis.
* Correlate cyber threat data and information from multiple sources to identify relationships, trends, and potential threats.
* Research and analyze technical information to develop evidence-based findings and conclusions.
* Prepare concise written assessments that clearly communicate analytical findings.
* Support conclusions with relevant evidence and articulate the operational or mission impact of analytical findings.
* Collaborate with mission partners and other analysts to support cybersecurity and intelligence requirements.

### **Required Qualifications:**

Candidates must meet the education and experience requirements for the applicable labor category level:

* **Senior:** Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) plus **6 years of relevant experience**.
* **Expert:** Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) plus **11 years of relevant experience**.

Relevant experience should demonstrate expertise in areas such as **cybersecurity analysis, technical or all-source intelligence analysis, anomaly detection, log analysis, Splunk, cyber threat correlation, behavioral analysis, and intelligence assessment development**.

**Position requires an active Security Clearance with appropriate Polygraph.**

**Pay Range:** $175,000 - $220,000

*The RealmOne pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Our approach to crafting offers considers various factors to establish an equitable and competitive compensation package. These considerations include, but are not limited to, the extent and intricacy of the role’s responsibilities, the candidate’s educational background, their work experience, and the specific competencies crucial for success in the role.*

***RealmOne Benefits:***

* ***Healthcare Coverage + Insurance:*** *Medical: Three (3) rich healthcare options through CareFirst with 100% or majority company-paid premiums. Tax-advantaged health savings account available with generous employer contribution. Dental + Vision: 100% employer-paid for employees and family, with a buy-up option available.*
* ***Retirement + Savings:*** *401K – 10% TOTAL CONTRIBUTION – 5% safe harbor – 5% annual profit share (both immediately vested!).*
* ***Paid Time Off + More:*** *4 weeks starting PTO – 11 federal holidays + 2 floating holidays – Paid hours for company-required training.*
* ***Career Growth + Development:*** *Access to FREE 24/7 learning via Udemy – Opportunities to participate in tech councils, industry initiatives, etc. – $7,500 annual Educational & Professional Development Assistance.*
* ***MORE BENEFITS…FOR EVERY LIFESTYLE!*** *– Paid parental leave – Annual swag drops – Flexible work schedules -Generous referral bonus program – Employee appreciation + family-friendly corporate events …and much more.*

***ABOUT US***

* *RealmOne is a mid-sized science and technology company dedicated to solving our customers’ toughest mission challenges.*
* *Headquartered in Columbia, MD., RealmOne supplies advanced cybersecurity, data science, and software engineering services and products to customers in the Government and commercial sectors.*
* *RealmOne delivers encompassing mission assurance and critical systems support to government customers across various U.S. locations to include Colorado, Georgia, Hawaii, Texas, Utah, and Virginia.*
* *RealmOne has won numerous awards, including Top Workplaces by the Baltimore Sun. Across more than 20 prime contracts, RealmOne is a premier innovator for the Government and Department of Defense, and our team is located across the United States.*

If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our nation's leaders.

  

As a Financial Intelligence Analyst on our team, you will leverage your understanding of international money laundering, threat finance, sanctions evasion, corruption and kleptocracy, and other illicit finance typologies to guide our clients’ investigations, analysis, enforcement efforts, or partnership engagements. You will evaluate financial data to identify and analyze indicators of money laundering activity. To develop deep financial intelligence insights, you will explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources, including intelligence reporting, open-source information, regulatory filings, financial transaction data, and blockchain transaction tracing. You will validate information to support evidentiary and analytical standards, and write assessments for presentation to regulators and senior policymakers.

  

As the authority in your topic, your client will look to you for time-critical recommendations, often under pressure. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills in data analytics, research and analysis, and analytical writing, brief senior decision-makers, share your methodologies with analysts and investigators, and work throughout the interagency environment to address illicit finance risks to the U.S. financial system. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you will have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our nation’s leaders and policymakers.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

* Experience with intelligence, law enforcement, and commercial financial databases
* Ability to work as a high-performing individual in a supportive team environment
* Ability to manage multiple simultaneous complex projects with minimal need for supervision
* Top Secret clearance

* Experience with the financial services industry, including compliance, asset and wealth management, securities, or banking operations
* Experience with regulatory rulemaking procedures

* TS/SCI clearance

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Organization**

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

### **About the Role**

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this critical mission, we are seeking a high-caliber Project Manager to serve as the lead Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) programmatic and technical advisor to a Government Program Office.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of national security innovation, directly advising federal leadership on the retrofit, fit-out, and initial operating capability (IOC) of a cutting-edge, Contractor-Owned, Contractor-Operated (COCO) high-density Artificial Intelligence (AI) Compute Datacenter. Partnering closely with premier commercial technology and aerospace leaders, you will oversee the conversion of an industrial/office facility into an accredited ICD 705 Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) housing advanced liquid-cooled high-performance compute (HPC) clusters. If you are passionate about bridging mission-critical national security mandates with modern AI infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Contractor Oversight & Technical Advisory:** Serve as the lead SETA advisor to the Government Program Manager (PM) and Contracting Officer Representative (COR), providing objective assessments of the Prime Contractor's technical deliverables, Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), design review packages (PDR/CDR), and commissioning test plans.
* **Contract Performance Auditing:** Monitor COCO operational performance benchmarks, verifying that commercial site modifications comply with contract specifications, power/cooling agreements, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), while auditing physical progress to inform deliverable acceptance.
* **Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) Management:** Baseline and maintain the government-side IMS in MS Project, aligning the Prime Contractor’s schedule with government interdependencies, tenant fit-out, mission milestones, critical-path analysis, and long-lead supply chain tracking (e.g., electrical switchgear, chillers, specialized hardware).
* **Accreditation & Physical Security Governance:** Track compliance with ICD 705 mandates, monitoring the Construction Security Plan (CSP), Construction Surveillance Technician (CST) logging, Fixed Facility Checklists (FFC), and TEMPEST assessments in coordination with the Accrediting Official (AO) and Certified TEMPEST Technical Authority (CTTA).
* **High-Density Compute Infrastructure Modernization:** Oversee MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) retrofits supporting high-density AI clusters, including medium-voltage power distribution, backup generation, UPS systems, and closed-loop liquid/chilled-water cooling systems across commissioning Levels 1–5.
* **Stakeholder Alignment & Executive Reporting:** Facilitate recurring Integrated Product Team (IPT) working groups, risk management boards, and vendor status reviews; maintain the Program Risk, Issues, and Opportunities (RIO) register; and author executive decision memoranda and briefings for senior DoD and Intelligence Community leadership.
* **SETA Boundary Adherence:** Operate strictly in a technical and programmatic advisory capacity, supporting federal decision-makers while maintaining strict compliance with non-inherently governmental function guidelines.

### **Required Experience/Clearance**

* **Security Clearance:** Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
* **Years of Experience:** Five (5) years of progressive project management experience within the federal government, DoD, or the Intelligence Community (IC), with demonstrated experience advising federal Program Managers or CORs.
* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical military/industry experience).
* **Infrastructure Acumen:** Practical working knowledge of mission-critical datacenter infrastructure, including MEP systems, power distribution, emergency generation, HVAC/chilled-water/liquid cooling systems, and enterprise compute rack hardware deployments.
* **Software & Project Tools:** Advanced proficiency with MS Project (critical-path schedule risk analysis), Microsoft Excel (advanced modeling), Jira, and Confluence.

### **Desired Experience**

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

* **Advanced Education:** Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
* **Professional Certifications:** Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or DAWIA / FAC-P/PM Level II/III in Project Management.
* **Acquisition Models:** Prior technical advisory experience with Contractor-Owned, Contractor-Operated (COCO) or Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facility acquisition mechanisms.
* **Advanced AI Hardware Familiarity:** Direct familiarity with high-density AI/ML hardware platforms (e.g., NVIDIA GPU clusters, direct-to-chip liquid cooling manifolds, InfiniBand networking topologies).
* **Accreditation Authority Experience:** Direct experience collaborating with IC/DoD Accrediting Officials (AOs) and CTTAs through final physical SCIF accreditation and Authority to Operate (ATO).
* **Datacenter Industry Credentials:** Datacenter operational certifications such as Uptime Institute (ATD/AOS), CDCMP, or LEED AP.

The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for success

CULTIVA Global Solutions is hiring a hands-on Program/Project Manager to support a federal agency’s GO.gov travel system in downtown Washington, DC. You will manage system configuration and operational support, coordinate testing and financial-system integration, and help travelers, approving officials and executives use the system effectively.

This role requires direct experience configuring a federal e-travel system. General project management, travel booking or processing authorizations and vouchers alone will not meet the technical needs of the position.

What you will do

· Administer approval workflows and routing rules, delegate and shared-approval structures, role assignments and user profiles in GO.gov test and production environments.

· Maintain the configuration workbook, document changes and validate them before production deployment.

· Support approval governance, including approver validation, approval-chain reviews, delegated-authority administration and training-compliance tracking.

· Coordinate travel-system and financial-system integration requirements and testing with the agency’s technology and finance teams.

· Support system integration testing and user acceptance testing, document defects, submit service desk tickets and work with GSA and the implementation contractor to track fixes through resolution.

· Develop and deliver training, office hours, standard operating procedures and practical guidance for travelers, managers and approving officials.

· Help users resolve travel authorization, voucher, profile and routing problems, escalating issues with clear documentation when needed.

· Support remaining transition and records-retention work from the previous travel system.

· Track implementation priorities, risks and issues, and prepare clear status and performance reports for government oversight.

What you bring

· At least five years of relevant performance experience in program/project delivery, systems implementation or federal travel operations.

· A bachelor’s degree or an education and experience combination that meets the applicable contract labor-category requirements.

· Experience with ConcurGov and GO.gov, including personally configuring approval workflows, user roles and profiles in a federal e-travel system.

· Experience testing system changes and documenting configuration decisions, issues and results.

· Expert Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams; Adobe and Power BI experience; working knowledge of SharePoint and OneDrive.

· Clear writing, presentation and communication skills, with a record of responsive support to staff and senior executives.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, sound judgment and discretion with sensitive records.

· Availability to work on-site in downtown Washington, DC, Monday through Friday.

Preferred experience

· Federal travel processes, budget execution and travel-system integration with a financial system.

· Developing user training and supporting an agency-wide system transition.

· Visio, Microsoft Project or Microsoft Office Specialist certification.

Schedule and hiring process

This is an eight-hour-per-day, five-day-per-week role, with working hours scheduled within the client’s 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern core window. Plan for five days on-site; any telework requires client approval.

The hiring process includes a phone screen, an interview with CULTIVA leadership and a meeting with the client team. A conditional offer is followed by the client’s background and suitability process and a nondisclosure agreement.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance; life insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts; 10 days of annual paid time off; 10 paid holidays; and LinkedIn Learning access. Candidates must have the ability to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing, providing data analysis and insights related to compensation, taxes, and benefits. * **Data Integrity and Accuracy**: Verify and validate payroll data, ensuring accuracy and completeness of employee compensation, tax deductions, and benefits
* **Payroll Processing**: Review timesheets, adjust pay calculations, and process payroll transactions, including direct deposits and checks

The Risk Intelligence Center (RIC) delivers actionable intelligence on the global security & threat landscape, providing decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property and assets and to help make the world a safer place.

The RIC is part of Securitas' new business unit, Security Risk Management (SRM), which is a holistic, intelligence-led approach to identifying, understanding, monitoring and acting on risks specific to each client and a critical component in the 'Insight 2030' strategy, which positions Securitas as the world's leading intelligence-led security partner.

As a **Senior Protective Intelligence Analyst,** you will play a vital role in supporting our mission to proactively identify and mitigate security threats through comprehensive analysis and strategic insights.

**Senior Protective Intelligence Analyst:**

* £40-45K per annum, dependent upon skills and experience
* Shifts operate on 4 on, 4 off (0700-1900)
* Based in Milton Keynes (in office)

**Essential Requirements:**

* You must be eligible to work in the UK on a permanent basis, without the need for sponsorship
* Live within a 45-minute (door-to-door) commute of the office in Milton Keynes
* Ideally, have 3-5 years' experience working in an intelligence or intelligence-related analytical role
* Strong knowledge of, and genuine interest in, current affairs and the global security threat landscape
* Well‑developed interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, constructively, and professionally as part of a team

To progress through the recruitment process, candidates must successfully complete each stage, including a written assessment and an in-person interview.

The RIC is currently based at Unity Place in Central Milton Keynes; however, we are due to relocate back to The Park MK in Wavendon, Milton Keynes, during the first half of 2027.

The role is responsible for operating and supporting the delivery of intelligence products and services to Securitas and Securitas’ customers. The role is suited to someone with 3-5 years’ experience in intelligence and / or investigations. Direct experience in an operational role is essential. The primary focus of the Senior Protective Intelligence Analyst is to lead the collection, processing and analysis of data and information to inform the production of intelligence products and services, and disseminate these to customers internally and commercially. The role will take the lead on complex and challenging customer Requests For Intelligence (RFIs).

The role reports directly into the Protective Intelligence Manager, and requires strong intelligence acumen, understanding of customer requirements, relationship building and networking skills, strong research, analytical and report writing skills, in addition to proficiency in IT systems including Microsoft Office and specific intelligence tools.

Working within a dynamic and demanding environment, the role requires flexibility and agility, including mobilising on short notice to meet operational requirements, and some evening and weekend work. The Senior Protective Intelligence Analyst will have an in-depth knowledge of the Protective and Global intelligence functions, providing support and guidance to both services and products. The role is Monday – Friday with a weekend rota. Travel may be required to visit customers on occasion. Responsibilities will evolve over time, with opportunities for ongoing development and progression.

* Support the management and the Direction of intelligence efforts (reactively and proactively), including proactively identifying, prioritising, and tasking intelligence requirements within the RIC, for both general reporting requirements and client specific requirements.
* Support the management of the Collection of data and information, including use of intelligence tools, and manual processes including research.
* Support the management of the Processing of intelligence into databases, forms, logs, systems, templates etc.
* Support the management of the Analysis of data and information using recognised intelligence techniques and supporting seniors with more complex and / or demanding efforts.
* Support the management of the Production of finished intelligence products autonomously, or with support / supporting seniors, including (but not limited to) alerts, analysis (assessments, reports etc.) and investigations. This includes both written products and verbal presentations.
* Support the management of the Dissemination of intelligence products to stakeholders, including internally within Securitas, and commercially to customers, both in the UK and overseas.
* Support the management and the drive of operational excellence through ongoing Evaluation and Feedback of intelligence services, including maintaining the highest level of consistency and quality. * Support the identification and development of new sources and methods of research to ensure that intelligence products reflect latest methodologies and best practice.
* Maintaining awareness of innovation within intelligence to develop and implement the latest techniques and tactics, best practice, and information relevant to the RIC and own self development.
* Support management and seniors and provide guidance to junior colleagues in order to maximise their development, efficiency, and morale.
