Job Description

**The role:**

An exciting opportunity has opened within the Eastern Region Special Operations Unit (ERSOU) for an experienced Intelligence Analyst to join our Sensitive Intelligence Unit (SIU).

The successful applicant will:

* Collect, collate, evaluate and analyse information from a wide variety of internal and external sources to investigate those involved in organised crime.
* Handle sensitive information and work within guidelines to develop opportunities to parallel and enhance the intelligence picture.
* Produce high quality analytical products in support of operational requirements.
* Make recommendations to direct operational teams and assist in the conviction of offenders.
* Work independently at pace and under pressure to support operational needs.
* Build relationships with partner agencies to increase knowledge and further opportunities for developing intelligence.
* Produce analytical products to an evidential standard and take an active role in peer review of products.

**About the Team**

The SIU is an exciting and dynamic place to work. Supporting operations in Force, ROCU and across partner agencies, we exploit and enhance intelligence from multiple sensitive data sources to target the highest threat and harm areas affecting the Eastern Region.

You will work alongside a team of skilled analysts and intelligence development officers to analyse, assess, review and develop investigations, making recommendations to drive business activity and inform tactical planning.

You will be at the forefront of new technologies and be encouraged to participate in trials and projects to directly influence future technologies across Law Enforcement and further your career development.

*As part of this role, you will be required to partake in an on-call rota, as the Sensitive Intelligence Unit is responsible for providing a 24/7 intelligence response for fast time crimes in action. This will include a requirement for some weekend working and on call, approximately one week in every eight.*

**Who We’re Looking For**

* An experienced analyst with a minimum of one year working as an analyst within Law Enforcement, ideally within intelligence.
* Ability to work with Windows based software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Experience working with communications data.
* Experience of CSAS / Chorus or equivalent customised databases.
* Well-developed numeric, analytical and research techniques.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Flexible approach to work and ability to self-motivate.

If you are a driven, self motivated analyst with attention to detail and a passion for dismantling our highest harm threats and OCGs then this could be the perfect next step in your career.

*Interested?* *P**lease see the attached Role Profile for further details including essential and desirable criteria*.

Please note: selected candidates may be invited to complete an assessment exercise as part of the recruitment process.

**WORK LOCATION**

This role will be based in Stevenage, Hertfordshire with the requirement to travel across the region when necessary. ERSOU supports principles of agile working and encourages staff from any force or location to apply for positions. However, due to the nature of the role, the successful candidate will be required to work at a designated site within Stevenage up to and including 5 days a week. There are occasional opportunities for agile work dependant on operational demands.

**ERSOU – Who are we and what we do**

Created in 2010, ERSOU is funded by the seven police forces that make up the eastern region, with Bedfordshire Police being the lead force. ERSOU is the Eastern Region Special Operations Unit, that oversees and delivers a regional level response to Serious and Organised Crime, and Counter Terrorism Policing for the Forces in the Eastern Region.

ERSOU is made up of both Officers and Police Staff from across the entire region and works closely with the 7 Forces and National Partners. The departments are unique, in that they offer opportunities to work and develop individuals professionally in specialist areas, often delivering capabilities that are provided by local forces.

Working for ERSOU presents a fantastic opportunity for you to learn and develop within a unique law enforcement community whose staff and officers are dedicated to protecting the public from the threat of terrorism and serious and organised crime.

We are committed to building a leadership team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from individuals who are currently underrepresented at senior levels, including women, Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates, disabled people, and those from LGBTQ+ communities.

We value the unique perspectives and experience that diverse leadership brings and welcome candidates who can help us drive inclusive policing and community engagement.

ERSOU as an employer can offer.

* Blue light card discounts
* Generous pension scheme
* Opportunities to get involved with networking groups such as the network of women, LGBTQ+, parent, carers, health, and wellbeing.

**VETTING**

This post is designated a ‘reserved post’ under the Civil Service Nationality Rules and is open only to UK Nationals. Working within the life science sector and familiar with a laboratory environment

At EDF, Success is Personal – and this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

You’ll join us on a salary starting of at least **£45,000 per annum**, with the potential for an annual bonus. This is a predominantly remote role, with flexibility to work from home alongside occasional travel to #Exeter, #Gloucester and #London.

Across smart meters, heating and electric vehicles, EDF’s Customers business is helping to shape a smarter, energy-saving future. We’re proud to be a Sunday Times Best Places to Work Top 10 Very Big Organisation for two years running and a Highly Commended workplace for disabled employees.

We're looking for a Business Analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, building strong relationships and helping teams navigate change. * Experience gathering, documenting and managing detailed requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams
* Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and working closely with developers throughout the software delivery lifecycle

* Helping move business processes from spreadsheet-based ways of working into strategic technology platforms
* Collaborating with data, forecasting, trading and operational teams to assess impacts and deliver successful change

Alongside a starting salary of at least **£45,000 per annum**, potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.

jobs.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Hello, we're Laka**

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

Raised an awesome Series B investment round

Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! )

Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

We've also achieved a 5\* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

### **The Commercial Operations Analyst role**

Laka's Commercial team manages partnerships with bike brands, retailers, leasing companies and fleet operators across the UK, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. We have fewer, bigger partners and long sales cycles. So what matters is getting the numbers right: every invoice, every commission statement and every report a partner sees. You'll own that, and build the reporting and processes that help the team grow its accounts.

You'll report to the VP Commercial.

**What you'll be getting up to:**

* Invoice and commission checks
* + Check the partner invoices Finance prepares each month: all of them there, on time, and right against contract terms, including group partners billed across several subsidiaries, entities and currencies (GBP/EUR)
  + Check partner commission statements before they go out, and make sure every partner gets theirs on time
  + Build checks and automation so errors are caught before anything reaches a partner
  + Own the contract register: commission rates, fees, billing entity, renewal and notice dates for every partner
* Reporting and dashboards
* + Build and maintain dashboards in Count (SQL) on partner performance: policies sold, capital acquired, revenue, commission, and trends by market and segment
  + Report account profitability: loss ratio and margin by partner (premium vs claims vs commission vs fulfilment costs), showing which accounts are worth growing and giving evidence for rate reviews and renewals
  + Own the weekly partner reporting with Finance and Data, including how accounts are tagged and mapped
  + Spot what looks off in the numbers and raise it with the account owner
* Partner QBRs
* + Prepare QBR packs for partners: performance, trends and agreed actions
  + Run the QBR calendar so key accounts are reviewed on a regular cadence
* Sales process and deal support
* + Map and tighten the handoffs from signed deal to go-live: contract, pricing set-up, onboarding, first invoice
  + Support deal modelling: commission economics, partner business cases and fee structures
  + Keep HubSpot tidy enough to be useful: accounts, owners, contacts and key dates
* Automation and tools
* + Find manual, repetitive work in the team and automate it (Sheets, Retool, Zapier, AI tools, scripts)
  + Keep templates, playbooks and process docs up to date

  
**Requirements**  

### **This role will be a great fit if you:**

* About you
* + 2 to 5 years in commercial ops, revenue ops, FP&A, business analysis or similar
  + Strong with numbers and data
  + Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Count, Looker, Metabase, Tableau or similar)
  + Rigorous: you reconcile before you send, and you build checks so the same mistake doesn't happen twice
  + Experience reconciling invoices, commissions or billing data, ideally across entities and currencies
  + Curious about automation and AI, and you've used them to remove manual work
  + Organised and autonomous, happy to build process where little exists, and confident pushing back when it isn't followed
  + Clear communicator with partners and internal teams
* Nice to have
* + Insurance, fintech or B2B2C partnerships
  + French, Dutch or German
  + Python or another scripting language
  + An interest in cycling

  
**Benefits**  

### **Our perks**

What can you expect from working at Laka?

Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London & Bristol (we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

Company bonus scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary in

* Lead discovery sessions across Store Operations, Merchandising, Allocations, Marketing, and E-Commerce to uncover goals, pain points, and unmet data needs
* Translate business asks into analytical briefs, functional specifications, and user stories actionable by BI developers
* Manage the analytics intake pipeline; own UAT on behalf of business stakeholders before deployment

* Design exception reporting frameworks that proactively surface outliers and opportunities across sell-through, inventory health, conversion, promotional effectiveness, and digital engagement
* Leverage AI-powered anomaly detection to enhance exception identification speed and precision
* Build scenario tools, trend projections, and what-if models to shift business partners from reactive to proactive

* Support day-to-day Global Retail IT operations — issue triage, intake management, resolution tracking, and SLA compliance monitoring
* Manage vendor relationships and support testing, validation, and rollout of retail technology initiatives including POS enhancements, clienteling tools, and BI platform upgrades
* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles

**Stakeholder Engagement & Enablement:**

* Partner across Store Operations, Merchandising, Allocations, Marketing, E-Commerce, Finance, Corporate Data & Analytics, and the BI Development team
* Facilitate working sessions, communicate project status, and deliver user training and self-service guides across reporting platforms
* Champion a data-driven culture — advocating for the retail business in every IT conversation

* Comfortable operating across global teams, time zones, and cultures in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field — or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in a Business Analyst, IT Operations, or Data Analytics role — preferably in consumer retail

Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking".

Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. jobs.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Hello, we're Laka**

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

Raised an awesome Series B investment round

Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! )

Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

We've also achieved a 5\* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

### **The Commercial Operations Analyst role**

Laka's Commercial team manages partnerships with bike brands, retailers, leasing companies and fleet operators across the UK, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. We have fewer, bigger partners and long sales cycles. So what matters is getting the numbers right: every invoice, every commission statement and every report a partner sees. You'll own that, and build the reporting and processes that help the team grow its accounts.

You'll report to the VP Commercial.

**What you'll be getting up to:**

* Invoice and commission checks
* + Check the partner invoices Finance prepares each month: all of them there, on time, and right against contract terms, including group partners billed across several subsidiaries, entities and currencies (GBP/EUR)
  + Check partner commission statements before they go out, and make sure every partner gets theirs on time
  + Build checks and automation so errors are caught before anything reaches a partner
  + Own the contract register: commission rates, fees, billing entity, renewal and notice dates for every partner
* Reporting and dashboards
* + Build and maintain dashboards in Count (SQL) on partner performance: policies sold, capital acquired, revenue, commission, and trends by market and segment
  + Report account profitability: loss ratio and margin by partner (premium vs claims vs commission vs fulfilment costs), showing which accounts are worth growing and giving evidence for rate reviews and renewals
  + Own the weekly partner reporting with Finance and Data, including how accounts are tagged and mapped
  + Spot what looks off in the numbers and raise it with the account owner
* Partner QBRs
* + Prepare QBR packs for partners: performance, trends and agreed actions
  + Run the QBR calendar so key accounts are reviewed on a regular cadence
* Sales process and deal support
* + Map and tighten the handoffs from signed deal to go-live: contract, pricing set-up, onboarding, first invoice
  + Support deal modelling: commission economics, partner business cases and fee structures
  + Keep HubSpot tidy enough to be useful: accounts, owners, contacts and key dates
* Automation and tools
* + Find manual, repetitive work in the team and automate it (Sheets, Retool, Zapier, AI tools, scripts)
  + Keep templates, playbooks and process docs up to date

  
**Requirements**  

### **This role will be a great fit if you:**

* About you
* + 2 to 5 years in commercial ops, revenue ops, FP&A, business analysis or similar
  + Strong with numbers and data
  + Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Count, Looker, Metabase, Tableau or similar)
  + Rigorous: you reconcile before you send, and you build checks so the same mistake doesn't happen twice
  + Experience reconciling invoices, commissions or billing data, ideally across entities and currencies
  + Curious about automation and AI, and you've used them to remove manual work
  + Organised and autonomous, happy to build process where little exists, and confident pushing back when it isn't followed
  + Clear communicator with partners and internal teams
* Nice to have
* + Insurance, fintech or B2B2C partnerships
  + French, Dutch or German
  + Python or another scripting language
  + An interest in cycling

  
**Benefits**  

### **Our perks**

What can you expect from working at Laka?

Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London & Bristol (we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

Company bonus scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary in

Position Overview:

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Procure-to-Pay** to help drive the transformation, standardization and continuous improvement of our end-to-end P2P processes and supporting systems.

**Your Mission**
================

As part of the **Finance Technology** team, you will act as a **business partner to Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders**, with the ability to understand the underlying business objective, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into efficient, scalable processes and system solutions.

Your role covers the **end-to-end P2P landscape**, from sourcing and contract lifecycle management through purchase requisitions, purchase orders, supplier invoicing, expense management, approvals, accruals and payment readiness, across applications including Workday Financials, Workday Procurement, Concur and CLM.

You will work at the **intersection of Business, Finance and IS**, ensuring that technology enables the right business processes rather than simply reproducing existing ways of working.

**We are not looking for a purely technical application specialist**. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Procure-to-Pay, Procurement and Finance transformation, ERP or business applications, combined with the ability to understand and navigate a complex multi-system environment. Knowledge of Workday Procurement, Concur or CLM is a strong advantage, but a strong P2P / Finance Systems profile with experience on other ERP or enterprise platforms will also be considered.

Responsibilities:

* **Act as a Business Partner for Procure-to-Pay**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's business model, Procurement and Finance processes and end-to-end P2P operating model.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Business stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges and pain points.
* **Challenge existing processes, requirements and assumptions**, rather than simply translating them into system specifications.
* Ask the right questions to distinguish between a genuine business need, an existing practice and a historical system limitation.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and improve processes across purchasing, supplier invoice management, expenses and contract lifecycle management.
* Recommend pragmatic solutions that balance business value, user experience, scalability, compliance and technical constraints.
* Help stakeholders move from a **“what we do today”** mindset to a **“what should the target process be?”**

* **Own P2P Process Analysis & Design**

* Map and document current-state and target-state P2P processes.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, manual activities, controls and risks.
* Define clear process ownership, responsibilities and hand-offs between Procurement, Finance, Legal, Business teams and IS.
* Design target processes in collaboration with Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency and appropriate standardization across countries, entities and business units.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process simplification across requisitioning, approvals, receiving, invoicing, expenses and contract management.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Finance Technology operating model and P2P roadmap.
* **Translate Business Needs into Effective Solutions**

* Lead functional analysis from business problem to solution.
* Gather business needs, but **challenge and refine them before translating them into requirements**.
* Define business rules, functional requirements, data requirements, approval rules, controls and acceptance criteria.
* Assess alternative solutions and make recommendations to stakeholders.
* Work closely with IS architects, application owners and integration teams to validate solution feasibility.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the **end-to-end business process**, rather than optimizing a single application in isolation.
* Assess upstream and downstream impacts before changes are implemented, including procurement operations, accounting, supplier management, compliance and reporting.
* **Own the End-to-End P2P Systems Perspective**
* The role will cover the interaction between the key applications supporting P2P, including:

**CLM Workday Procurement Concur Workday Financials**

* The candidate will:
  + Understand how business processes and data flow across the application landscape.
  + Identify dependencies and impacts between applications.
  + Define functional requirements for system changes and integrations.
  + Work with IS Integration teams to ensure consistent end-to-end data flows.
  + Challenge solutions that create unnecessary manual work, compliance risk or downstream accounting impacts.
  + Identify opportunities to eliminate duplicate data entry and improve automation across contracts, requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and expenses.
  + Contribute to the definition of data ownership and business rules across the P2P landscape.
* The candidate is **not expected to be an expert in every application**. Instead, we are looking for someone who can quickly understand new systems, connect them to the underlying business process and identify the implications of changes across the landscape.
* **Drive Functional Delivery**

* Act as the functional lead for P2P initiatives and projects.
* Coordinate activities across Procurement, Finance, Legal, Business, IS and external partners.
* Translate business objectives into actionable functional deliverables.
* Contribute to project planning, prioritization and roadmap definition.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions requiring stakeholder attention.
* Ensure that functional decisions are properly documented and communicated.
* Follow initiatives through from initial business problem to implementation and stabilization.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Manager H/F
jobs.description:
Description

Veolia, leader mondial des services à l'environnement, participe chaque jour à construire la sécurité environnementale. Présent sur les cinq continents, le groupe dépollue, décarbone et régénère les ressources à travers des solutions concrètes combinant ses expertises dans le domaine de l'eau, des déchets et de l'énergie.
  
  
Partenaire de nombreux industriels et collectivités, l'Activité Recyclage & Valorisation, entité du groupe Veolia, a pour ambition de devenir le producteur de ressources renouvelables de référence en France. Nous proposons une gamme complète de solutions innovantes à toutes les étapes du cycle des déchets, de leur collecte à leur transformation et valorisation en matière et en énergie, grâce aux étapes de tri et de traitement.

Poste

VOTRE MISSION
  
  
Rattachée à la Direction Direction Services aux Entreprises, au sein de la filière Commerce, Valorisation et Innovation, l'équipe développe de nouvelles offres B2B pour accompagner les entreprises dans leur transition vers l'économie circulaire.
  
  
Acteur de référence de la gestion et de la valorisation des déchets, la DSE évolue dans un marché en pleine transformation, marqué par les évolutions réglementaires, la montée en puissance de l'économie circulaire, la consolidation du secteur et l'évolution des attentes des clients. Pour éclairer ses décisions et soutenir sa conquête de nouvelles parts de marché, l'entreprise crée une équipe Market Intelligence.
  
  
VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :
  
  
Structurer la fonction et manager l'équipe :
  
  

* Définir la vision, le périmètre et la feuille de route; recruter, encadrer et faire monter en compétences les deux analystes;
* Etablir les processus, méthodologies, référentiels et outils de veille et d'analyse;
* Coordonner les demandes des parties prenantes internes.

  
Réaliser des études sectorielles et de marché :
  
  

* Analyser les marchés de la collecte, du tri, du traitement et de la valorisation;
* Etudier les différentes typologies de déchets, filières et zones géographiques;
* Evaluer le potentiel de nouveaux marchés et anticiper les évolutions réglementaires, technologiques et économiques.

  
Déployer une veille stratégique et concurrentielle :
  
  

* Suivre les concurrents, clients et prospects, la réglementation, les technologies, les prix, les appels d'offres et les opérations de fusion-acquisition;
* Diffuser des analyses et alertes directement exploitables par les équipes.

  
Contribuer à la stratégie commerciale de conquête :
  
  

* Identifier et prioriser les cibles, analyser les appels d'offres et les renouvellements de contrats,
* Elaborer des plans de conquête avec les directions commerciales et fournir des analyses de comptes stratégiques.

  
Communiquer et influencer :
  
  

* Présenter les analyses et recommandations à la direction générale et aux comités de direction;
* Adapter les livrables aux besoins des publics et agir comme partenaire stratégique des directions métiers.

Profil

Niveau de formation : Bac +5 (école de commerce, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent)
  
  

* Expérience : 8 à 10 ans en market intelligence, études de marché, conseil en stratégie ou stratégie d'entreprise. Une première expérience en management d'équipe ou en encadrement de projet est indispensable.
* Expertise : maîtrise de l'analyse sectorielle, du dimensionnement de marché et de la veille concurrentielle; capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées.
* Culture commerciale et data : bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux B2B, notamment des appels d'offres et des cycles de vente longs; maîtrise d'Excel avancé et d'outils de visualisation tels que Power BI ou équivalent. Des notions de CRM sont appréciées.
* Connaissance sectorielle : une expérience dans les déchets, l'environnement, l'énergie ou les utilities est un atout, mais l'expertise méthodologique prime.
* Qualités personnelles : leadership pragmatique, rigueur intellectuelle, esprit critique, orientation résultats, curiosité, autonomie et capacité à travailler en transversalité avec diplomatie.
* Communication : excellente capacité de synthèse à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec une réelle aisance pour convaincre.
* Langues : anglais professionnel.

Mot clés: Graphiste, Chargé de communication, Chef de projet

Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

### **\uD83D\uDCC4 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE**

*Rattaché.e à la finance, vous travaillez en partenariat étroit avec le directeur commercial groupe et ses directeurs sectoriels et régionaux pour construire et challenger les plans à court, moyen et long terme avec les marques et organiser le suivi de la performance vs. ces plans.*

*Vous faites partie d’une équipe de Business Controllers Groupe et reportez au Commercial Controlling manager groupe*

### **\uD83C\uDFAF MISSIONS**

We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)**

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

**Role summary**

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.

* Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early.

* Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones.
* Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early.
* Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams.

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education.
* A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies.
* Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile).
* Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
* The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management.
* Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives.
* Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence.
* Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping.

* A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM.
* Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates.

CrowdStrike’s Intelligence Analysis Cell (IAC), a team within CrowdStrike Counter Adversary Operations (CAO), is seeking to hire a Senior Intelligence Analyst with high expertise in North Korea and the broader Asia-Pacific region.

lifestyle brand.

This role is equal parts analytical, collaborative, and operational, with core deliveries spanning reporting, analytics, exception intelligence, multi-platform solution design, and forward-looking insight. The ideal candidate brings a solution-first mindset, is fluent across analytical platforms, and is passionate about turning data into decisions that move the retail business forward.
